description:
ART ARK® is a social enterprise dedicated to sharing and selling Australian Aboriginal Art to promote social and economic opportunities in remote communities while combating unethical dealers.

We partner exclusively with not-for-profit, community-run, and publicly audited Aboriginal Art centres that prioritise the interests of their artists. When you choose to buy Aboriginal Art through ART ARK®, you commit to fairness, authenticity, and respect. Our mission transcends selling art and involves advocating for authenticity and fighting against exploitation in the Aboriginal Art market.

ART ARK® Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Welcome to ART ARK®. Thank you for your interest in our Affiliate Program.

These Terms and Conditions apply to individuals or organisations participating in the program as affiliates (“you”) who refer customers to ART ARK® (“we” or “us”). By joining the program, you agree to abide by these terms. If you do not agree, please do not participate.

1. Acceptance into the Program

We reserve the right to approve or decline any affiliate application at our sole discretion. There is no legal recourse for a rejected application.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

Your affiliate link is automatically generated and can be customised to direct to specific products or collections.

If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the last link clicked will receive credit.
If you have been assigned a coupon code, it will be visible in your dashboard.
You may not promote any coupon that hasn’t been assigned to you.

Affiliates are welcome to share their links on digital channels such as social media or email, and traditional channels such as print and community networks.

3. Commissions and Payment

You will earn a commission on successful sales referred through your link, based on the commission structure set out in your dashboard. Commissions are calculated on the order total, excluding GST, shipping, or additional fees.

Payments are made based on completed orders only. Cancelled, refunded, or chargeback transactions are not eligible.
You must provide valid payment details in your settings to receive payouts.

Referral commissions are paid monthly, at the end of each month.

Commission and payment status is visible in your dashboard.

4. Marketing Tools

We may provide you with promotional assets (e.g. banners, logos, and campaign images) via the “Marketing” section of your dashboard. You may use these to promote ART ARK® across your channels.

5. Referral Network (if enabled)

If the network feature is activated, you may invite others to join the program under your referral. You’ll earn a network commission when your referred affiliates generate sales. The rate will be set out in your dashboard.

6. Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies to track referral activity. If users disable or clear cookies, tracking may not work and commissions may not be recorded.

The cookie duration is stated at sign-up. If a customer makes a purchase within that period, even on a later visit, you’ll receive credit — no additional clicks are required.

7. Leaving the Program

You can leave the program at any time by emailing us at guy@artark.com.au.

Final Note

Thanks for reviewing these terms. We’re excited to have you onboard and look forward to working together to share ethical, community-sourced Aboriginal art.

If you have any questions, please reach out at guy@artark.com.au.
